$description: Single-line editable text field with persistent label and optional help, error, prefix or suffix.
name: Text Field

behavior.label: Always persistently visible; placeholder is not a label.
behavior.error: Show actionable textual feedback and indicate invalid state programmatically; do not rely on red border alone.
behavior.readOnly: Retain focusability and value selection when applicable; do not style as disabled.
behavior.resize: Content and helper/error text must wrap and the field must not clip enlarged text.

accessibility: Associate label with input; connect descriptions and error messages via accessibility APIs (aria-describedby on web).
Expose required/invalid/read-only/disabled states natively; never disable just to show validation.
Do not announce every keystroke as an error; communicate validation at appropriate moments.
Ensure a visible focus indicator with contextual contrast as necessary.

web: Use semantic HTML controls, keyboard focus-visible, and 24×24 CSS px minimum targets; prefer more space for touch.
Retain browser zoom and allow labels to wrap or controls to grow.
Use <label for> and <input>; aria-invalid with readable error text when invalid.
ios: Respect 44pt minimum interactive hit area and Dynamic Type; prefer native Button/Control semantics.
Use native enabled/disabled and accessibility label/state APIs.
android: Respect 48dp minimum interactive target and nonlinear font scaling; prefer native Compose/View control semantics.
Use native enabled/disabled and accessibility semantics.
